title: feat(spec): a save of a connector's served form drops a leftover undeclared auth key and names it
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9CDSh9Q8hhMV3sRgRxkeLrC)_ Part of #28640 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none Ruling-ref: 6566912252 Skills-docs: none — no authorable key, accepted value or metadata type changes; the change is a read redactor's result type and the save answer's advisories, which no skill teaches ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：连接器旧数据里 `auth` 未声明键上的明文(如 `auth.token`),现在普通「读取 → 保存」一次就会从库里清掉，保存结果的 `advisories` 逐个点名被清掉的键。 - 为什么改：裁决 ②B(6566912252)。这些键门口早已拒收、运行时也从不读，带回去只是让明文一直留在库里。 - 风险与回滚：只影响连接器 `auth` 未声明键这一类；其他所有隐藏位置(请求头表、datasource 等)照旧带回。回滚即还原本 PR。 - 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-redaction.ts`(`planCarryForward` 跳过不带回的位置)、`packages/spec/src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.ts`(标记)、`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-redaction.ts`(新成员与契约说明)。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.metadata-redaction.test.ts -t "28640"`,预期 6 条全绿。 - 需要你做的：批准新的公开名 `notCarriedForwardKeys` 与提示规则名 `withheld-key-dropped`(见 Acceptance notes),其余席位落地。 ## What changes - **`MetadataRedactionResult` gains `notCarriedForwardKeys?: string[]`** (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`). It names the positions among `redactedKeys` that are withheld AND not carried forward. It is a **subset** of `redactedKeys`, not a disjoint list: `redactedKeys` still names every withheld position, so every existing reader that asks "was anything withheld?" through `redactedKeys` (`redactStoredMetadataBody`, `redactMetadataItem`, `metadata-manager`'s served-document walk) withholds exactly what it did before. Optional, and absent means none, so the `datasource` built-in, the schema-derived redactors and every registered redactor (`service-automation`'s flow redactor included) keep carrying every withheld position forward with no edit. The interface docblock says what a read exit and what a save's carry-forward do with each list. - **The connector redactor marks its undeclared `auth` keys** (`redactConnectorItem`, item 1 of its module note). Each such key is named in both lists. A cleared value there (`null`, `''`, an empty map) is withheld too now, the way items 7 and 8 already withhold cleared undeclared keys: every instance-auth kind is a strict shape that refuses the key whatever it holds, so serving `auth.token: null` back made a plain read then save fail with `unrecognized_keys`. Every other withheld connector position (the four maps, `authentication`, credential URLs, undeclared top-level, `retryConfig` and `actions` keys, a non-object `auth`) stays carried forward. - **The carry-forward skips those positions and reports what it dropped** (`metadata-protocol`). `planCarryForward` never grafts a not-carried-forward path; it records each one the stored row holds and the incoming body does not hold. A value the incoming body itself holds there is the author's word, judged at the door, and not a drop. `carryForwardRedactedValues` and `redactedPathsCarriedForward` keep their signatures; a new package-internal `carryForwardRedactedValuesReportingDrops` returns the body and the dropped paths. `carryForwardRedactedCredentials` (the private save-door body) now answers `{ item, dropped }`. - **The save answer names each drop on `advisories`**, the existing channel a 2xx save carries its non-gating findings on (no second channel). One `warning` per dropped position: rule `withheld-key-dropped`, `where` = `connector "NAME"`, `path` = where the value sat at rest in the advisory spelling (`connectors[0].auth.token`), never the value. The key is still omitted when there is nothing to report. A draft save drains and reports too. `SaveMetaItemResponseSchema.advisories`'s description says so, and `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` is regenerated from it. ## Why Ruling ②B (6566912252, the maintainer's 「同意」): "The redactor can mark a position "withheld and not carried forward"; the class covers undeclared keys under `auth` … A normal save of the served form therefore drops them instead of re-grafting them, and the save result names the dropped keys in its notices, so a drop at rest is loud, never silent." ## Tests New, all against rows written below the door (direct seed / stored body), as a pre-strict row would be: - `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.metadata-redaction.test.ts` › `[#28640 ②B] a save of the served connector form drains an undeclared auth key` (6): read serves without `auth.token` → save of the served form stores none and `advisories` names `connectors[0].auth.token` (value absent from the answer); CONTROL the header map beside it round-trips unchanged; the drain converges (second save: no `advisories` key); a draft save drains and reports; a cleared `auth.token: null` row now saves; CONTROL a datasource row's carry-forward is unchanged and its answer carries no `advisories`. - `metadata-protocol/src/metadata-redaction.connector-undeclared-keys.test.ts` › `an undeclared auth key is not carried forward` (5): drop + report while the undeclared root key and the header map are still carried; the runtime gate's `redactedPathsCarriedForward` no longer names it; the author's own value at that position (a switched `auth` kind that declares the key) is not a drop; removing `auth` drops and reports; CONTROL no drop on a row without one. - `spec/src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.test.ts` › `withheld and not carried forward` (8): both lists name every undeclared `auth` key; unknown `type`; the three cleared forms are withheld and the served form then passes `DeclarativeConnectorEntrySchema` (it fails before redaction); CONTROL every other withheld position leaves the member absent; CONTROL a non-object `auth` is still carried; only the `auth` key is marked beside the other positions. - `spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-redaction.test.ts` › `notCarriedForwardKeys` (4): the built-in names it; a row whose ONLY withheld position is not carried forward is still redacted by the stored-row seam (pins subset-not-disjoint); CONTROL the datasource built-in and the derived webhook redactor never set it; a registered redactor without it type-checks. Forced edits to existing tests: none. ## Acceptance notes - **Contract review:** per the ruling this is a `MetadataRedactionResult` contract change (spec + metadata-protocol) and takes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record; that record is the reviewing seat's, not this PR's. - **Two new public names await the maintainer:** the member `notCarriedForwardKeys` and the advisory rule id `withheld-key-dropped`. Alternatives considered for the member: `droppedOnSaveKeys`, `drainedKeys`. - **Deviation from the card delta's expected surface:** the delta said undeclared `auth` keys land "in the new list, not in `redactedKeys`". They land in both (subset). A disjoint list fails open: three existing readers decide "nothing withheld" from `redactedKeys.length === 0` (`redactStoredMetadataBody` and `redactMetadataItem`, and `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` `redactServedDocument`), so a connector row whose only withheld position was an undeclared `auth` key would have been served in cleartext by every one of them, and by any third-party reader. The subset keeps all of them correct with no edit; only the carry-forward reads the new member. The ruling's words ("the redactor can mark a position") fit either. - **Cleared undeclared `auth` keys are now withheld too** (they were served as written). Not in the delta; included because the save of their served form was a 422 before this PR and the ruling wants that save to drain them. - **File surface beyond the claim's four files:** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (the save door threads `dropped` into `advisories`: 3 hunks) and `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` (the `advisories` description). - **Docs:** no hand-written page describes the connector read redaction or the save's carry-forward (`content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` already sends credentials to `auth.credentialRef`), so the regenerated `protocol.mdx` and the changeset are the documentation change. - **Not in scope, unchanged:** a non-object `auth` (item 4) and every `authentication.KEY` (item 2) are still carried forward; `sys_metadata_history` snapshots keep the old body (served redacted by the stored-row seam); ①A (#29341) and the ③A export marker (#29342). ## Verification Readings on head `04ba73c2207187c08cb3566eab228eab9658976d`, tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack`. All on the merged head (main at `7f277a86` merged in), each heavy run under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (`VERDICT command-exit 0` on every one). | Run | Reading | | --- | --- | | `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'` | 78/78 tasks | | `@objectstack/spec` focused (redaction + protocol tests) | 3 files, 333/333 | | `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` focused (5 redaction / carry-forward files) | 5 files, 113/113 | | `@objectstack/spec` test (full) | 791 files, 23463 passed + 1 todo | | `@objectstack/spec` typecheck (incl. scripts + test typecheck) | exit 0 | | `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` test (full) | 304 files passed + 4 skipped; 22166 passed + 26 skipped | | `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` typecheck (`src/**/*`, tests included) | exit 0 | | `@objectstack/objectql` save / publish / advisory answer conformance | 3 files, 45/45 | | `@objectstack/metadata` redaction bookkeeping + service | 2 files, 81/81; typecheck exit 0 | | `@objectstack/service-automation` flow / connector credential files | 4 files, 72/72; typecheck exit 0 | | `@objectstack/runtime` flow credential files | 2 files, 13/13; typecheck exit 0 | | ESLint `--no-inline-config` on every changed `.ts` | exit 0 | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` | clean after the post-merge regen (the one prerequisite red was a pre-build dist) | | `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --event` on this body | exit 0 (`yes (widening)` / `none`, patch) | **Ablations** (pre-merge head, restored by blob hash after each): disabling the carry-forward's not-carried-forward skip turns 6 tests red; deleting the connector redactor's `notCarriedForwardKeys` push turns 7 red.
